ai_summary: Aegis Logistics Limited delivered an exceptionally strong Q1 FY '27, reporting a 212% year-on-year profit after tax growth to INR 545 crores and a 184% EBITDA increase, primarily driven by record performance and healthy margin expansion in its Gas distribution business. This robust growth is underpinned by aggressive infrastructure expansion across multiple ports, including the commissioning of a specialized ammonia terminal at Pipavav with a strategic partner, and a substantial $5 billion capex pipeline through FY 2030-31, positioning the company for significant future expansion with no immediate red flags identified.
